                    DEFENDANT META PLATFORMS, INC.’S
          MOTION TO DISMISS PLAINTIFF’S FIRST AMENDED COMPLAINT

         Defendant Meta Platforms, Inc., pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12(b)(6),

  hereby moves to dismiss Plaintiff’s First Amended Complaint for failure to state a claim upon

  which relief can be granted. The reasons supporting this Motion are set forth in an

  accompanying memorandum of law filed contemporaneously with this Motion.

  Dated: August 21, 2026
